description: Search TikTok videos by free-text keyword (not hashtag — use tiktok.search.hashtag.list for that). Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence — not the tool you are calling.

conversation_id.description: Echo the conversation_id from the server's previous response. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous response.

datePosted.description: Optional upload date filter for video results.

limit.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

maxResults.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

max_results.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

offset.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

pageSize.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

query.description: Search query text for TikTok videos.

region.description: Optional two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code for localized search results.

sortBy.description: Optional sort order for search results.

trim.description: When true, returns a smaller response with fewer fields.

name: tiktok_search_videos_list
title: Search TikTok videos
